customStructureDefinitions.name: Glossary
customStructureDefinitions.description: An item scheme based custom structure whose items are glossary terms. The items property of instances is always named 'items' and holds zero or more terms; the isPartial behaviour of item schemes is inherited. The term hierarchy is modelled explicitly through the 'children' property.

descriptions.en: An item scheme based custom structure whose items are glossary terms. The items property of instances is always named 'items' and holds zero or more terms; the isPartial behaviour of item schemes is inherited. The term hierarchy is modelled explicitly through the 'children' property.

properties.description: The terms of the glossary. As the definition extends ItemScheme, the 'items' property plays the item role; its custom type must extend Nameable.
A non-item property alongside the items: the statistical subject area covered by the glossary, taken from a concept.

customTypes.name: Glossary term
customTypes.description: A glossary term. Plays the Item role of the scheme and so must extend Nameable.

descriptions.en: A glossary term. Plays the Item role of the scheme and so must extend Nameable.

properties.description: The definition of the term, a localisable text reported once per language.
Narrower terms of this term. A custom type may reference itself, allowing an explicit hierarchy of items.
